description: This file defines the LocationModel class within the OrangeHRM project. It models the data structure for a location, including properties like country, city, address, and contact details, and is used for serializing location data in the Admin API module.

classes.name: LocationModel
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for serializing Location entity details for the OrangeHRM API, including nested properties such as country details and employee count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LocationModel by setting the entity and defining filters and attribute names for serialization.
